messages.subject: INLA download and running problem
parts:
Hi INLA users,

I got an error as after running the current testing version in R 4.4.1. It shows a prompt that INLA was built under 4.4.2 version. Can you tell me where is the error? How do we resolve this? 

"/home/alm20014/rlibs3/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla.mkl: /lib64/libm.so.6: version `GLIBC_2.29' not found (required by /home/alm20014/rlibs3/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/inla.mkl)"

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] INLA download and running problem
parts:
you need to download and install another linux build, do

inla.binary.install()

and chose one according to your linux version/variant.

you can do this many times so its just trial an error if you don't know
